changes.name: semanticSlack_eq_namedSlack
changes.complete_raw_header:

    semanticSlack i r t = namedSlack i r t :=
changes.before_body:
fin_cases r
  all_goals
    norm_num [semanticSlack, semanticExpr, namedSlack,
      ownership_eval_notation_add, ownership_eval_notation_sub,

    <;> first

      | (split_ifs <;> ring1!)

changes.name: namedSlack_complement
changes.complete_raw_header:
private theorem namedSlack_complement (i : Fin 15) (k : Fin 6) (t : Point) :
    namedSlack i (complementRow k) t =
      newCap t - (selectedSum t +
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin 8 => 0 < j ∧ j < middleIndex k), t j) +
          2 * t (middleIndex k)) :=
changes.before_body:
fin_cases k <;>
    norm_num [complementRow, middleIndex, namedSlack, Fin.lt_def,
      Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_mk, Fin.coe_ofNat_eq_mod, Nat.reduceMod]
    <;> rfl
